topic: Restore suction to a vacuum cleaner
core_question: What do I do when my vacuum cleaner loses suction? (secondary: How do I get a proper browned crust when searing a steak?)
answer_summary: Empty a full dust bin or bag, clear clogs from the hose and brush roll (often hair or string), and wash or replace a clogged filter, since these are the most common causes of lost suction.; after the topic shift: Pat the steak completely dry, heat a heavy pan with oil to very high heat, and sear undisturbed for a couple minutes per side to build a brown crust, then rest before cutting.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
